Draft — pending legal review

This policy is a working draft. It has not been reviewed or approved by a legal professional, it has no effective date yet, and it may change before it is adopted. Items marked “Decision pending” are still to be decided by Think Positive Always.

1. About this policy

This policy explains how thinkpositivealways.com uses cookies and similar technologies, such as your browser's local storage and session storage. It should be read together with our Privacy Policy.

2. Our approach in short

  • We do not use advertising cookies, advertising networks or social media tracking pixels.
  • We do not use Google Analytics or any other third-party analytics service.
  • With your permission, we count visits with our own usage statistics tool, which stores nothing on your device. You can accept or reject it, and change your mind at any time, in Cookie settings.
  • Cookies are only set when you sign in, and are used to keep you signed in securely.
  • A few features you choose to use (such as your cart) remember information in your browser's own storage.

3. Strictly necessary cookies

These first-party cookies are set only when you sign in. They keep you signed in and protect your account against forged requests. They are not used for tracking or advertising, and the website's sign-in would not work without them, so they cannot be switched off in Cookie settings.

Durations are the website's default settings. Only people who sign in receive these cookies.
NamePurposeHow long
tpa_customerKeeps a customer signed in to their account.Until you close your browser, or 30 days if you choose “Keep me signed in”
tpa_customer_csrfProtects a customer's account actions against cross-site request forgery.Same as tpa_customer
access_token_cookieKeeps a member of our team signed in to the admin area.15 minutes
refresh_token_cookieRenews a team member's sign-in securely.14 days
csrf_access_token, csrf_refresh_tokenProtect admin actions against cross-site request forgery.Same as the sign-in cookies

4. Information stored in your browser for features you use

Some features remember your choices in your browser's local storage or session storage. This information stays in your browser, is not sent to us automatically, and is used only for the feature concerned. Session storage is cleared when you close the tab.

NamePurposeWhere and how long
tpa:privacy-choicesRemembers your Cookie settings.Local storage, until you change your settings or clear your browser's storage
tpa:cartRemembers the items in your cart.Local storage, until you remove them or clear your browser's storage
tpa:currencyRemembers the display currency you chose for prices.Local storage, until you change it or clear your browser's storage
tpa:dismissed-announcementsKeeps announcements you have closed hidden.Local storage, until you clear your browser's storage
tpa-reader-preferencesRemembers your course reader settings, such as text size and spacing.Local storage, until you change them or clear your browser's storage
tpa-assignment-draft:…Keeps a backup of a course assignment answer while you write it.Local storage, until the answer is submitted or cleared
tpa-guest-order:…Lets you return to an order you placed without an account.Session storage, until you close the tab
tpa-guest-accessHolds the access code from your purchase link while you view your purchases.Session storage, until you close the tab

5. Usage statistics

To understand which pages are read and improve the website, we count page visits with our own tool. It does not use cookies and stores nothing on your device. When you open a page, your browser sends us the page address, the page you came from and, for campaign links, the campaign labels in the link.

  • We do not store your IP address or your browser's details. To count unique visitors per day, we create a short code from a shortened version of your IP address, your browser's details and a random value that is replaced every day, so visits cannot be linked from one day to the next.
  • Visits are not recorded on private pages, such as your account, checkout or the admin area.
  • We respect your browser's Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals: when either is on, no visit is counted.
  • The statistics are not used for advertising, are not sold or shared, and are not combined with your account.
  • Individual visit records are deleted after 90 days, and daily totals after 12 months.

Usage statistics are optional. We ask for your permission before counting your visits, and you can switch them off, or back on, at any time in Cookie settings.

6. Third-party content and services

  • Videos. Some articles include YouTube or Vimeo videos. They load only when you press play, using YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode and Vimeo's do-not-track option. Once a video loads, the provider may use cookies or similar technologies under its own privacy policy.
  • Payments (planned). Online payments are not available yet, and no payment provider is connected to this website. We plan to use Paystack; when payments start, you will be taken to the provider's secure payment page, which may use cookies under its own policies. We will update this policy before then.
  • Links to other websites. Other websites you visit from our links have their own cookie and privacy policies.

7. Your choices

  • Use the Cookie settings link at the bottom of every page to see and change your choices.
  • You can also block or delete cookies and stored information in your browser's settings. If you block strictly necessary cookies or storage, signing in, your cart and some other features may not work.
  • Turning on Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control in your browser also switches off usage statistics.

8. Changes to this policy

We review this policy whenever we add or change a technology that uses your device. If a change affects your choices, we update the version shown in Cookie settings and, where required, ask you again.

9. Contact

Questions about this policy? Please visit our contact page for the current ways to reach us. For privacy requests, email contact@thinkpositivealways.com.
